horizons.note: All open: hypothetical simultaneous settlement, including later expirations. Today only: positions expiring today. Lifetime net payoff, not daily ledger change; excludes closed positions. No remaining time value or forecast probability.

All outstanding at target: hypothetical simultaneous settlement of current positions expiring on or after 2026-11-13. Target session only: positions expiring on that date. Earlier expirations are omitted, not projected or carried as realized P&L. Lifetime net payoff after fees, not next-day ledger change; no remaining time value or forecast probability. Grid remains centered on the current SPX reference; no new trades assumed.
